title: Linear Models for Data
student_objective: I can write and use a reasonable linear model for bivariate data, make predictions, and judge whether a prediction is reasonable from the data range and scatterplot.

concept_cards.title: A line of fit follows the overall trend
concept_cards.content: A reasonable linear model runs through the middle of a roughly linear scatterplot so that points are balanced above and below the line.

concept_cards.title: The slope has contextual meaning
concept_cards.content: In y=mx+b, m is the predicted change in y for each 1-unit increase in x. Always include units when interpreting the slope.

concept_cards.title: Use the model to predict
concept_cards.content: Substitute an x-value into the model to estimate y. A model prediction is an estimate, not a guaranteed outcome.

concept_cards.title: Interpolation is usually safer
concept_cards.content: Predictions inside the observed x-range are interpolation. Predictions far outside the observed range are extrapolation and are usually less reliable.

model.teacher_signal: Student chooses a line that does not follow the center of the scatterplot.

slope.teacher_signal: Student does not interpret model slope in context.

prediction.teacher_signal: Student substitutes incorrectly or treats prediction as exact.

items.prompt: For the model y=3x+5, predict y when x=4.
items.tutor_behavior: Substitute the x-value into the model.

items.prompt: In y=2.5x+8, what is the slope?
hint_steps: m is the coefficient of x.

items.prompt: A line of fit for hours studied x and predicted score y is y=6x+52. Predict the score for 5 hours of study.
items.tutor_behavior: Model substitution and interpret as a prediction.

solution_steps.explanation: The model predicts a score of 82.

items.prompt: A model for distance y (miles) after x hours is y=48x+12. Interpret the slope 48.
items.answer_key: distance increases about 48 miles per hour
items.tutor_behavior: Attach output units per input unit.
hint_steps: Slope is change in y per 1 unit of x.
y is miles and x is hours.
The model predicts about 48 additional miles per hour.

solution_steps.explanation: The slope uses output units divided by input units.
That is the contextual meaning of the slope.

items.prompt: Observed x-values in a data set range from 2 to 12. Is a model prediction at x=10 interpolation or extrapolation?
items.tutor_behavior: Compare the requested x-value with the observed range.

solution_steps.explanation: The requested x-value is within the observed data range.
Predictions within the data range are interpolation.

items.prompt: Use y=4x+7 to predict y when x=6.
A model for cost y dollars after x months is y=15x+40. Interpret the slope.
items.answer_key: cost increases about 15 dollars per month
hint_steps: y is dollars and x is months.

solution_steps.explanation: Slope is change in cost for one additional month.

items.prompt: Observed x-values range from 10 to 30. Is predicting at x=65 generally interpolation or extrapolation?
items.tutor_behavior: Flag predictions outside the observed range.
hint_steps: This is extrapolation and is generally less reliable.

solution_steps.explanation: The requested value lies beyond the observed data.
The model is being extended outside its evidence range.

items.prompt: Use y=2x+9 to predict y when x=11.
A scatterplot has a clear upward linear trend. Which line is more reasonable as a fit: one running through the middle of the points or one far above nearly all points?
items.answer_key: one running through the middle of the points
items.tutor_behavior: A reasonable fit balances points above and below.
hint_steps: A fit should represent the center of the trend.
Avoid a line that misses nearly all points on one side.
Choose the line through the middle.

solution_steps.explanation: A reasonable fit passes through the center of the data cloud.

items.prompt: A model predicts 74.6 students for a count of people. What is a reasonable whole-number interpretation?
items.tutor_behavior: Interpret a continuous model in a discrete context.
hint_steps: A student count must be a whole number.

solution_steps.explanation: Round to a meaningful whole-person estimate.

items.prompt: Use y=5x+12 to predict y when x=7.
In y=-3x+90, interpret the slope when x is time in hours and y is gallons remaining.
items.answer_key: the amount decreases about 3 gallons per hour
items.tutor_behavior: Use the negative sign and correct units.
hint_steps: Negative means y decreases as x increases.
The amount decreases about 3 gallons per hour.

solution_steps.explanation: The model predicts a decrease of 3 gallons each hour.

items.prompt: Observed x-values range from 1 to 20. Is a prediction at x=18 interpolation or extrapolation?
items.tutor_behavior: Check whether the input lies inside the data range.
hint_steps: That is inside the observed range.

solution_steps.explanation: The input lies within the observed range.

items.prompt: Observed x-values range from 0 to 25. Which prediction is generally more trustworthy from the same model: x=20 or x=80?
hint_steps: The x=20 prediction is generally more trustworthy.

items.prompt: A line of fit is y=1.8x+22. Predict y when x=15.
